title: Sources: databases, APIs, files and events

videos.script: A pipeline reads somebody else's system. And the kind of system decides what can go wrong. {{kinds}} Ana reads the shop's orders, then their lines. Four seconds apart. A day of trade lands in between. {{torn}} The lines now belong to orders she never counted. Nothing failed. Every number was right for its own moment. {{moment}} The price API answers one page at a time, and refuses when she asks too fast. {{api}} The distributor's file stops at line six hundred, and loads without a word. {{file}} The next day it arrives in another language. {{drift}} And the website sends some clicks twice, and some the day after. {{events}} Four sources. Four failures. And the dangerous ones all have something in common. They succeed. {{succeed}}
